- **要做：** 按导航声明展开/折叠（或记住管理员的选择）。
- **完成标准：** 未声明折叠的分组默认展开。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **R2-T2-U01**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup sidebar, the system administrator.
- **Now (18.0.0):** on landing, Configuration (13 items) and Advanced are collapsed. Only Advanced declares `expanded: false` in the served nav.
- **Cost:** 14 of the 41 items are hidden on first view, including Localization, Email and Authentication.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), U-01; [`00-setup-home.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/00-setup-home.png), [`00-setup-sidebar-configuration-expanded.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/00-setup-sidebar-configuration-expanded.png).

## Landing

- objectstack `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup.app.ts` ~:116 is the only `expanded: false` in the Setup app (read on objectstack `origin/main` `7b047b44`).
- The console's sidebar group default (objectui): a group with no `expanded` must open, as the declaration says.

## Done when

- A Setup group with no `expanded: false` opens on first view; Advanced stays collapsed.
- A sidebar test over a declared and an undeclared group.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `sidebar`, `expanded`, `collapse`. 1 open hit: #12724 (the AI build chat), not on point; the closed #13220 and #13246 are form-group keyboard defects. **New.**
